main_body: dead weeping tree with hanging branches and trunk
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat front silhouette with vertical hanging tendrils and a flat base line at rows 52-55. Unlike a 3/4 tree whose canopy forms a foreshortened top volume and whose roots spread in an ellipse on the ground plane, this has no top surface or 3/4 root base.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, multi-layered volume of the reference trees, the candidate is a flat mass of repetitive vertical 2px-wide brown strips outlined in near-black, with only 3-4 brown tones and a flat horizontal bar for the root base.
